      FAQ

      Questions testers and examiners ask.

      Does Madison decide whether a control is effective?+

      No. It proposes a rating with the numbers behind it. Your tester decides every exception and a named person at your bank signs the conclusion.

      What happens when an owner doesn't send the evidence?+

      Madison chases until the deadline. Anything still missing comes to your tester, who extends the deadline, escalates it or records the gap against the control. An owner can also say the evidence doesn't exist, and that answer is recorded too.

      Can our examiner recheck the work?+

      Yes. Every figure in the workpaper links back to the extract, the sample draw and the evidence file it came from, and every decision shows who made it and why.

      We already have a GRC platform. Do we replace it?+

      No. It stays your system of record. Madison does the testing work and feeds the results back in.
